entities.summary: Alfredo Claudino Baptist Read Griffin is a Dominican former professional baseball shortstop. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for from 1976 to 1993 for the Cleveland Indians, Toronto Blue Jays, Oakland Athletics, and Los Angeles Dodgers.
